operators.name: custom_reshape
semantics: Performs the same reshape as torch.reshape(x, (-1, x.size(-1))) for step_001 and torch.reshape(x, self.mel_shape) for step_003.
For step_001, input is [batch, num_samples] and shape is (-1, input.size(-1)). For step_003, input is complex64 [batch, n_fft//2+1, frames] and shape is self.mel_shape.
Returns a view when possible; must preserve element order and data pointer semantics.

operators.name: custom_stft
semantics: Matches torch.stft(input, n_fft, hop_length, win_length, return_complex=True) exactly.
Uses rectangular window (implicit None window), center=True, pad_mode='reflect', normalized=False, onesided=True by default.
Output shape is [batch, n_fft//2+1, frames] where frames = 1 + (num_samples - n_fft) // hop_length = 33 for input length 16384.
Preserves default strides of torch.stft: [frames*(n_fft//2+1), 1, n_fft//2+1] as in checkpoint.
Reshapes input [1024,16384] to same shape [1024,16384] because -1 infers 1024, x.size(-1) is 16384.
No copy occurs because input is contiguous and shape is identical.

reference_steps.source: x = torch.stft(x, n_fft=self.n_fft, hop_length=self.hop_length, win_length=self.win_length, return_complex=True)
semantics: Performs STFT with n_fft=4096, hop_length=512, win_length=4096, rectangular window, center=True, pad_mode='reflect', normalized=False, onesided=True.
Output shape [1024, 2049, 33] as per checkpoint, dtype complex64.
Reshapes complex tensor [1024,2049,33] to mel_shape (1024,2049,-1). The -1 dimension resolves to 33, resulting in same shape.
No copy occurs; view has same strides [67617,1,2049] as checkpoint.
Returns the final complex64 CUDA tensor of shape [1024,2049,33].
